sounds.name: cave-drip
sounds.credit: Synthesised for Taste in numpy: an upward-gliding sine (the Minnaert resonance of the bubble a drop entrains) with a soft impact click, through a 2.8 s dark noise reverb. No recording.

sounds.name: stream
